paragraphs: In the club hour, Teacher Kim asked Leo and Mia to draw a town map. The map was for a new page of Explorers' Blog. Leo used a black pen for the roads and colored pens for the buildings. Mia wrote the key at the bottom of the map. The map was big, and it fitted on one page. This is what she wrote:
"Map key. A blue bus is the bus station. A red ball is the football club. A green book is the town library. A yellow star is the museum. A gray plane is the airport. A gold coin is the bank."

Mia read the map to Leo. "The school is in the middle of the map," she said. "The museum is on the right of the school." "The library is across the road from the museum." "The football club is behind the school." "The bus station is in front of the school." "The bank is next to the bus station."

"Where is the airport?" asked Leo. "It is far from the school, at the top of the map," said Mia. "It is outside the town, so we do not walk there." "You need a bus to go there." Leo looked at the map and smiled. "I have not drawn the plane yet," he said. He drew a small gray plane at the top of the map.

"Next Saturday, the Explorers will walk to the museum," said Mia. "During the walk, we will walk past the bus station and the bank." "You need money for the museum ticket." "The ticket is twenty baht." "Use the key to find each place," said Leo. Leo wrote the name of each place under its picture, and Mia checked them. Teacher Kim looked at the map. "It is easy to read," she said.
text.summary: Leo and Mia make a map of the town with a key for Explorers' Blog. Mia reads the map and tells what is where, and she tells the way for the next Saturday walk to the museum.
